data.body:
AC13 evidence, recorded here because a pytest transcript is a run artifact and cannot live in the repository. AC13 is now tagged [non-codebase].

Command, run from the worktree with its venv first on PATH:
  pytest -q tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py

RED, against the tree before the fix (origin/main at a006c83c5fd), with only the new tests added:

  FAILED tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py::test_local_web_search_no_results_exception_returns_empty_list
  FAILED tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py::test_local_web_search_ddgs_failure_returns_single_unavailable_sentinel
  FAILED tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py::test_local_web_search_non_ddgs_failure_returns_single_unavailable_sentinel
  FAILED tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py::test_local_web_search_sentinel_serializes_to_model_visible_title_and_href
  FAILED tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py::test_t1_rubric_grants_only_unverified_authority_to_the_local_failure_sentinel
  FAILED tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py::test_t1_rubric_treats_zero_results_as_unverified_not_absent
  FAILED tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py::test_adr_0063_records_the_local_failure_boundary_reargument
  7 failed, 20 passed in 3.04s

The 7 red tests map to the defect exactly: DDGSException escaping on the no-results message, DDGSException escaping on any other message, a non-DDGSException (httpx.ConnectError) escaping, the sentinel not reaching model-visible serialization, both missing T1 rubric clauses, and the missing ADR 0063 re-argument.

GREEN, same command against the same tree with the fix applied (commit cb27a071c76, merged as Gerrit 3027):

  27 passed in 1.72s

The 20 pre-existing tests stayed green throughout, which is the guard on Tool.function.__self__ and max_results surviving the change.

Full gate on the same tree: make verify gave 17 failed, 20370 passed, 107 skipped in 2706.91s. The 17 are exactly the known macOS-arm64 pandoc 'Bad CPU type' failures (13 test_wiki_render, 3 test_rich_text_cutover, 1 diff_comments_cutover_neutral) and nothing else.
